integrity: The algebraic proof and two reproducible standalone programs are contained in the accompanying files. No authorship or independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Explicit formula only for UT_4(F_q), q a prime power. Commutation and conjugation counts verified exhaustively for q=2,3,4 and literal centralizer counts for q=2,3; unrestricted formula rests on a finite-field counting proof. A 2020 published ordinary commuting-probability expression disagrees with directly enumerated q=3 ordinary commuting pairs. Historical priority is provisional, and no independent validation is claimed.
title: Conjugate-commuting probability in the first class-three unitriangular group
